# `param-description-length`

**Tool rule** · `warning` · on by default

A parameter description says what the value is and its format in one sentence; long ones cost tokens on every call and bury the constraint.

A tool rule judges one tool from its own definition, so it runs everywhere: `lint()`, `lintTools()`, the CLI, the Playwright fixture, the audit crawler and the ESLint plugin.

## Options

| Option | Default |
| ------ | ------- |
| `max`  | `150`   |

## Configuring it

```ts
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "param-description-length": false } }); // off
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "param-description-length": "warning" } }); // change severity
lint(snapshot, { rules: { "param-description-length": { max: 150 } } });
```

```bash
npx @swissspidy/webmcp-lint tools.json --rule param-description-length=off
```

```js
// eslint.config.js
{ rules: { "webmcp/param-description-length": "error" } }
```
